title: Pher Na Hwey
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Pher Na Hwey" where he speaks about trust, faith, relationship, love, lies & how all these aspects impact our relationships.

title: Roz Mitiye Kaise
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Roz Mitiye Kaise" where he says in relationships there shouldn't be any ego and people should try to control their anger for the betterment of their relationships.

title: Subodh Beech Pari
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Subodh Beech Pari" where he elaborates on family bonds. He says when an understanding person tries to resolve a fight, he always aims at creating a win-win situation.

title: Ek Saadhey Sab
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Ek Saadhey Sab" where he says, we must focus on one task at a time; if one tries to work on multiple tasks at the same time, none of the tasks will be accomplished.

title: Kariye Sukh
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Kariye Sukh" where he says, people can't be truly happy if they make others sad. One must take care to ensure that one's happiness does not cause sadness to others.

title: Uttam Jan So
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Uttam Jan So" where he says, just as the saline sea leaves its saltiness and becomes sweet on meeting the clouds, one should always keep the company of good people.

title: Maarag Chalte Jau
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Maarag Chalte Jau" where he says, a person walking on a path is on a journey and if he falls do not criticize him, as he is at least trying to reach somewhere.

title: Bigdi Baat Banai
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Bigdi Baat Banai" where he says, if things go wrong, there is no use of dwelling on it, but a new beginning should be started afresh.

title: Ari Chotau
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Ari Chotau" where he says, never consider your enemies weak, less or ordinary because even a small spark can destroy a big stack of hay.

title: Je Na Hoye
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Je Na Hoye" where he says, people who are strong and internally powerful are like flowing water, they can't be still in life and always want to keep flowing or moving.

title: Ati Parichaen
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Ati Parichaen" where he talks about how familiarity breeds contempt. Hence, similarity is comforting, but you need diversification to grow and appreciate differences.

title: Chale Jo Panth
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's Doha "Chale Jo Panth" where he speaks about how not to be overconfident about ourselves. He says there should be a give & take policy only then your talent can grow.

title: Bade Bade Saun
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Bade Bade Saun" where he says, a storm destroys the biggest of trees, but the small plants remain safe, similarly, we should be humble to be protected from the storm of anger.
